About the job

The Ecommerce Execution Specialist is responsible for supporting the daily operations of New Era Mexico’s Ecommerce channel, ensuring accurate management of the product catalog, digital content, website, and mobile application.

This role supports the execution of product launches, commercial campaigns, and digital merchandising activities, helping to deliver a seamless customer shopping experience and contributing to online sales growth through accurate content implementation, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration.




Key Metrics:




Product Upload Accuracy: Percentage of products published correctly, ensuring all product information, images, pricing, attributes, and content are complete and error-free.
Site & App Accuracy: Accuracy and functionality of website and mobile app updates, ensuring published information is correct and aligned with commercial priorities.
Launch Execution: Timely and accurate publication of products, collections, and commercial campaigns.
Content Optimization: Level of digital content maintenance and optimization, including SEO improvements on product pages.

Responsibilities




1. Product Catalog Management

Upload, update, and maintain products within the Ecommerce platform.
Validate product information (descriptions, images, pricing, categories, attributes, and multimedia content) to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Review and follow up on products with missing information or assets.
Monitor product inventory availability in Shopify to ensure accurate product visibility across digital channels.

Update collections, categories, and menus within the website and mobile application.
Support the digital merchandising of products according to commercial priorities and seasonal campaigns.
Select products for commercial initiatives such as Fitted Friday, MLB Weekend, NFL Sundays, and other seasonal activations.
Ensure published content is aligned with brand guidelines and commercial objectives.

Perform functional reviews of the website and mobile application to identify errors or improvement opportunities.
Execute navigation and content testing before and after product launches and campaign activations.
Follow up on issues identified within the Ecommerce platform.
Coordinate product and campaign launches with the relevant internal teams.

4. Content Optimization & SEO/AEO/GEO

Optimize product pages by applying basic SEO best practices.
Improve product titles, descriptions, and content elements to enhance product searchability and discoverability.
Ensure published information contributes to an improved user experience.
Apply basic knowledge of SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) principles to optimize digital content.

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Business, Ecommerce, or a related field.

description:
About the job

Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description

The Business Development Representative (BDR) / Lead Qualifier is responsible for generating new business opportunities through high-volume outbound calls and email outreach to schools and teachers across the U.S.

In this role, you will: Proactively prospect and engage educators to introduce WorldStrides programs, qualify leads by identifying teachers interested in organizing student travel experiences, consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for calls and qualified leads, and collaborate with the Sales team by passing high-quality opportunities for closing.

This is a goal-driven, outbound sales role where success depends on your ability to handle rejection and stay motivated, build rapport quickly over the phone, maintain strong activity levels daily, and meet weekly and monthly goals in order to achieve additional compensation through a set commission structure.

You’ll work with a wide range of educational travel programs (history, science, national parks, and more), giving you constant opportunities to connect with new prospects and refine your sales and communication skills.

Responsibilities


Make calls and leave messages for teachers nationwide and use talk tracks for live calls.
Send follow-up emails.
Work on special projects, including periodic competitive calls, calls to unassigned schools, specialty schools and other telemarketing efforts.
Periodically research schools to help identify top prospects and maintain the database. Use templates to create and send flyers and update PowerPoint presentations.


Qualifications


Desired work experience in sales, marketing, promotions or telemarketing.
Proficiency in relevant computer applications including CRM.
Desired knowledge of customer service/sales principles and practices.
Six months or more experience in sales/lead creation/lead qualifying with Telephone sales experience preferred
Good data entry/keyboard skills
Familiar with office rules/office environment
High school diploma or GED required
Advanced (85%+) English level
Desired knowledge of sales and marketing principles and strategies
Proactive
Organized


Work Perks


Fun & driven environment.
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, life, accidental death and dismemberment, accident, critical illness, and disability insurance.
+10% of gross salary as food stamps.
1 paid volunteer day & 25 PTO* days to start – accrue up to 28 over 3 years, 4 mental health days, and 5 bereavement days.
Statutory Holidays by Mexican Federal Labor Law.
Tuition reimbursement up to five thousand, two hundred fifty dollars annually or one thousand dollars towards professional certification annually.
Flexible work schedule providing on-site and hybrid opportunities.
Encouraged participation in our Employee Resource Groups and Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion council.
Fitness opportunities. Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Paid statutory parental leave.


WorldStrides, a global organization, is committed to educate and serve communities worldwide. Our commitment is fueled by the passion of our team members and partners to make experiential learning accessible, while also being socially, environmentally, and ethically responsible. Together, we accomplish this by investing in initiatives to promote inclusion, diversity, and sustainability.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, WorldStrides is committed to building a diverse workforce, supported by an environment that promotes inclusion and belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, J-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire. Tired of tweaking your resume?

This is your chance to show us.

AI-powered workflows
Social commerce
E-commerce

No endless interview process.

No guessing what we’re looking for.

No resume keywords standing between you and an opportunity.

We care less about where you’ve worked and more about what you can do.

We’re looking for people who are:


Curious
Coachable
Resourceful
Competitive
Strong communicators

Apply to have a conversation with a member of the Terrific team about joining the bootcamp.

This is your moment.

description:
About the job

Position

Digital Marketing Specialist – Virtual Experiences

Job Description

Arrow Electronics is a global provider of products, services, and solutions to industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions. Arrow Electronics guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of $30.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. The company maintains 228 locations worldwide with over 85 countries served.

We are looking for a dedicated and detail‑oriented Digital Marketing Specialist – Virtual Experiences to join our Marketing Center of Excellence. In this role, you will be responsible for the end‑to‑end planning, execution, and optimization of webinars and virtual events delivered to global audiences. This position offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment where operational excellence, process quality, and measurable business impact are key priorities.

What You’ll Be Doing


Planning and executing live webinars and virtual events end‑to‑end, including event setup, registration, live production, recording, and post‑event follow‑up.
Managing event logistics on virtual event platforms such as Microsoft Teams Live, ON24, GoToWebinar, or similar tools, ensuring a seamless attendee and speaker experience.
Building and coordinating event invitations and registrations, including audience segmentation, email communications, reminders, and real‑time registration monitoring.
Training and supporting internal and external speakers through platform guidance, rehearsals, and live technical moderation during events.
Acting as a virtual events platform administrator, maintaining templates, access, troubleshooting issues, and continuously improving engagement features such as polling, Q&A, or captions.
Managing a global virtual events calendar and collaborating with regional marketing teams across different time zones.
Coordinating with external agencies and vendors when additional production support is required, including budget and delivery oversight.
Tracking event performance and preparing post‑event reports covering attendance, engagement metrics, and lead or pipeline attribution.


What We Are Looking For

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

Marketing Operations Specialist

Location: Mexico City

Modality: Hybrid

You will report to: Global Marketing Manager

TheMarketing Operations Specialist owns the daily execution and stability of opportunity routing and operational processes supporting Pre‑Pipeline and distributor-led opportunity flows. You will implement routing changes, Service level agreement monitoring, exception handling, and record reprocessing with global governance.

You will lead and improve the systems and workflows behind Early Stage Opportunities (ESOs), ensuring accurate routing, proper ownership understanding, and seamless opportunity progression across systems.

Main Responsibilities

Routing Execution & Operational Stability


Implement and maintain LeanData routing for opportunities with care for global standards
Manage LeanData logic (matching, routing, ownership understanding)
Implement routing updates, manage exceptions and re-routing, and ensure Service level agreement behavior functions as intended
Monitor routing health, investigate failures, and coordinate resolution with your team and LeanData support


Opportunity & Workflow Management


Support Salesforce opportunity workflows
Ensure ESO (Early Stage Opportunities) creation and progression flows correctly
Maintain data quality and system governance across opportunity processes
Support attribution and reporting (e.g., Full Circle)


Operational Work (Hands-on)


Perform record reprocessing and operational remediation for stuck or failed records
Maintain runbooks for recurring issues and standard operating procedures for routing operations


Test & Release Support


Support testing/UAT for routing-related changes and validate outcomes post-deployment
Document routing behavior changes and communicate impact to regional SMEs and partners


Team member Support


Be the first operational contact for routing issues and questions
Partner with regional SMEs to understand recurring friction points and improve operational clarity


Success Measures (Examples)


Reduced routing defects and faster time-to-resolution
Lower backlog of reprocessing / stuck records
Service level agreement behavior and fewer escalations from regions
Data quality and accurate opportunity routing
Predictable and scalable process execution


Qualifications

Must-Have Profile


Salesforce hands-on experience (opportunities, workflows, data management)
LeanData experience (required)
Experience working with opportunity processes (not only lead management)
Experience with Full Circle or attribution tools
Background in RevOps, Sales Ops, or GTM systems


Ideal Profile & Role Expectations


Operate as a hands-on Individual Contributor, with ownership of systems
Complex routing and workflow issues and implement sustainable fixes
Capability to translate our needs into system logic and automation
Comfortable working in with global your team
Focus on process standardization, scalability, and continuous improvement

About the job

Company Introduction

WorldStrides is the global leader in educational travel and experiential learning. The company was founded in 1967 to provide middle school travel programs to Washington, D.C. and has grown to provide a wide range of programs for more than half a million students annually to over 100 countries around the world. WorldStrides offers experiential learning programs in educational travel, performing arts, language immersion, career exploration, service-learning, study abroad, and sports. Each of these experiences helps students to see beyond the classroom and to see the world – and themselves – in new ways.

Job Description

The Business Development Representative (BDR) / Lead Qualifier is responsible for generating new business opportunities through high-volume outbound calls and email outreach to schools and teachers across the U.S.

In this role, you will: Proactively prospect and engage educators to introduce WorldStrides programs, qualify leads by identifying teachers interested in organizing student travel experiences, consistently meet and exceed monthly targets for calls and qualified leads, and collaborate with the Sales team by passing high-quality opportunities for closing.

This is a goal-driven, outbound sales role where success depends on your ability to handle rejection and stay motivated, build rapport quickly over the phone, maintain strong activity levels daily, and meet weekly and monthly goals in order to achieve additional compensation through a set commission structure.

You’ll work with a wide range of educational travel programs (history, science, national parks, and more), giving you constant opportunities to connect with new prospects and refine your sales and communication skills.

Make calls and leave messages for teachers nationwide and use talk tracks for live calls.

description:
About the job

Role: Head of Content

Location: Mexico City (remote, with weekly in-person syncs)

Working pattern: EST overlap required

Reporting to: Head of Marketing




About Cosign

Cosign is the fastest growing prop-tech company in the United States, revolutionizing the $4 trillion rental industry with a market-leading, one-of-a-kind rent guarantee product. Our mission is to expand housing access for renters and boost occupancy for landlords. Backed by top entrepreneurs, venture capital firms, and real estate investors, Cosign is built by experienced landlords and managers for landlords and managers who deeply understand the rental market's needs.




Our Mission Continued

Cosign is on a mission to expand access to housing by helping landlords approve more qualified renters, without increasing risk. We partner with owners and property managers to close the qualification gap caused by conditional approvals, thin credit files, and the absence of guarantors, materially improving leasing conversion and occupancy. We're building toward a near future where every U.S. property offers Cosign to renters who struggle to qualify, expanding housing choice while helping owners and operators convert demand into signed leases.




Our Hiring Philosophy

At Cosign, we seek exceptional talent with relentless intellectual curiosity, individuals who:

Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement
Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues
Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize
Create innovative solutions others believe impossible




We deliberately seek these rare, high-impact performers who attract similar talent. While most companies avoid hiring these exceptional individuals due to their demanding nature, we actively pursue them. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard.




We believe average talent builds average companies. By assembling a team of exceptional performers, we're creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and set new standards of excellence.




The Opportunity

We are expanding our executive presence on LinkedIn, and we need someone exceptional to help us do it well. This is not a standard content marketing role. You will own the voice of our most visible leaders, turning rough ideas, voice notes, and meeting moments into content that builds brand authority, generates real engagement, and positions us as the defining PropTech company in the U.S. rental market.




You will work directly alongside the Head of Marketing and our founders, meaning your fingerprints will be on the content that shapes how the industry sees us. Every post, thread, and campaign you produce is a direct representation of the company. Speed, originality, and editorial judgment are non-negotiable.




One important note: this is a writing role in the truest sense. We expect original, creative thinking that reflects genuine understanding of our business and voice. There is a written component to our interview process. Submissions that rely heavily on AI-generated content will not move forward. We use AI as a workflow tool, not a ghostwriter.




Key Responsibilities

Executive content strategy and production: own the LinkedIn presence of our founders and senior leaders, transforming voice notes, rough ideas, and business updates into polished, high-performing content that builds authority and drives real engagement.
Brand voice and consistency: define and maintain the distinct tone of voice for the company and key individuals across all written channels, ensuring every piece sounds authentic, credible, and on-brand.
Content calendar and execution: plan, schedule, and publish content across LinkedIn and relevant channels, managing multiple drafts, revision cycles, and feedback loops with discipline and speed.
SEO and GEO integration: embed keyword strategy and search optimization into content production without sacrificing voice or readability, contributing to our visibility in both traditional and AI-driven search environments.
Performance analysis and iteration: track engagement and content performance, using data and feedback to continuously sharpen strategy, tone, and output.
Cross-functional collaboration: partner with the Head of Marketing and founders to align content around product launches, partnerships, market moments, and business milestones.
Competitive and trend intelligence: continuously benchmark how competitors and industry thought leaders show up on LinkedIn, identifying opportunities to differentiate and stay ahead.




About You

We are looking for someone exceptional who takes our brand personally. You have a natural feel for LinkedIn and know exactly what makes people stop scrolling and engage. You bring fresh, original ideas to every conversation and hold yourself to a very high standard of writing and thinking.




You work fast, take responsibility, and do well even when things aren't clearly defined. You can take a quick voice note or a rough idea and turn it into a great post without needing a lot of direction. Everything you create has a clear purpose and helps the business grow.




Preferred Experience

We are looking for an exceptional writer with genuine passion for brand, content, and storytelling. Someone who lives on LinkedIn, understands what actually performs on the feed, and can produce content that educates, provokes, and converts.

3-5+ years of experience in content creation, copywriting, or brand writing for a technology, real estate, FinTech, or startup brand.
Demonstrable experience writing for founders, executives, or high-profile individuals on LinkedIn, with a portfolio that shows range, originality, and strong editorial judgment.
Strong SEO and GEO fundamentals: you understand how to write for both human audiences and search without sacrificing quality or authenticity.
Ability to work from ambiguity: you can take a voice note, a rough brief, or a half-formed idea and turn it into something worth reading.
Fluency with AI tools for research and workflow acceleration, paired with the editorial discipline to ensure everything you produce sounds original and human.
Excellent communication skills and the confidence to work directly with senior leadership in a fast-moving, high-expectation environment.
Genuine curiosity about people, businesses, real estate, and how category-defining companies build their brand in public.




What Makes This Opportunity Different

This is an opportunity to join one of the fastest-growing companies in U.S. PropTech at a pivotal moment in our growth. You will play a direct role in shaping how the industry sees us while helping housing providers create better experiences for residents, renters, and property teams across the country.




You will work alongside a team of exceptional performers, have direct access to senior leadership, and have real ownership over outcomes from day one. We move fast, we take care of our people, and we are building something that genuinely matters.




Working at Cosign

Our marketing team is based in Mexico City. This role is remote, but you'll join weekly in-person syncs with the team, so being based in or near Mexico City is required. We work with meaningful overlap with US Eastern Time.




Cosign is looking for someone who is comfortable operating with pace, accountability, and a high degree of ownership. The right person will be energized by the opportunity to build something within a growing company and shape how the world sees us.

About the job

About The Role

Uber Advertising's Measurement Science team is looking for an analytical and strategic problem solver to partner with Sales and help our advertisers achieve their revenue targets. This isn't just about crunching numbers; it's about navigating the massive, often messy, scale of the world's largest mobility and delivery platform to find what actually moves the needle.

As a key member of our LATAM insights offering, you will translate billions of data points into high-quality, actionable stories. The pace here is fast, and the environment is frequently ambiguous. You'll thrive if you have the grit to dig into proprietary metrics, the adaptability to shift priorities when market dynamics change, and the ownership to deliver "white-glove" service to our highest-priority global clients. This role is for someone who finds energy in complexity and wants to build the future of advertising measurement from the ground up.

What You'll Do

Analyze and Insight-Drive: Manage end-to-end post-campaign reporting and insights for a dedicated book of business, ensuring advertisers understand exactly how their spend translates to impact.

Partner with Giants: Deliver bespoke, deep-dive analyzes for some of the world's largest advertisers, helping them navigate Uber's ecosystem to grow their business.

Evolve the Playbook: Deeply master Uber's proprietary metrics and constantly evolve how we communicate data-driven insights to stay ahead of industry standards.

Advocate for the Region: Establish a deep understanding of local nuances by partnering cross-functionally with Account Executives, Merchant Operations, and Strategy teams in Mexico City and across LATAM.

Own the Pressure: Map to high-revenue driving clients, delivering white-glove service while managing the high stakes and rapid turnaround times inherent in digital advertising.

Navigate the Tech Stack: Leverage SQL, Python, and advanced visualization tools to unblock data bottlenecks and provide clarity to internal and external stakeholders.

Basic Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or Operational Research). 
 5+ years of experience in data analytics, measurement and insights, advertising, or AdTech. 
 Proficiency in using SQL and Python (or similar analytics programming) for data querying and analysis . 


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience with online advertising measurement methodologies, including ad servers, DSPs, DMPs, and programmatic buying platforms. 
 Experience designing and implementing A/B and multivariate tests and applying statistical concepts to real-world business problems. 
 Proficiency in data visualization tools like Looker, Google Data Studio, or Tableau to communicate complex insights. 
 Strong storytelling skills with a track record of providing actionable insights to large enterprise customers in a digital advertising organization.

About the job

At Fortive, we empower creativity and bold thinking to unlock breakthrough solutions and accelerate innovation. We are committed to building diverse, high-performing teams and believe that inclusive talent strategies create a competitive advantage in the markets we serve.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly strategic and proactive Strategic Sourcing Partner, Commercial to drive top-of-funnel talent strategy across critical commercial functions, including Sales, Customer Support, Marketing, and Business Development.

This role is focused on talent market mapping, proactive pipelining, and engagement of passive candidates. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in commercial talent markets, thrives in ambiguity, and excels at identifying and attracting top talent ahead of demand. You will partner closely with recruiters, TA leaders and hiring managers to shape talent strategies and ensure strong, diverse pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

This is a pipeline-first role focused on proactive sourcing, early-stage candidate screening, and talent market strategy, not full-cycle recruiting.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Talent Mapping & Market Intelligence


Conduct in-depth talent market research to identify key talent pools, competitors, and emerging trends
Provide insights on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, and hiring risks to inform workforce planning


Advanced Sourcing Strategy


Design and execute innovative, multi-channel sourcing strategies to attract high-caliber, diverse talent
Leverage tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-enabled sourcing platforms, and market mapping techniques


Proactive Talent Pipelining


Build and maintain robust pipelines of passive candidates aligned to critical and future hiring needs
Engage candidates early and nurture long-term relationships to ensure ready-now talent pools


Candidate Engagement & Experience

Build credible relationships with top talent to position Fortive as an employer of choice


Partnership with Talent Acquisition & Business Leaders

Participate in intake sessions and ongoing calibration to refine search strategies


Data-Driven Sourcing Excellence


Track and analyze sourcing metrics (pipeline health, conversion rates, diversity mix) to optimize effectiveness
Continuously refine sourcing strategies based on performance insights

Activate employer branding strategies through sourcing channels, social platforms, and talent communities
Serve as a market-facing ambassador for Fortive


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Talent Acquisition, Sourcing, or related HR discipline
4+ years' experience in strategic sourcing for commercial roles (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Business Development)
Proven track record of building pipelines for hard-to-fill and niche roles
Deep expertise in sourcing tools, including LinkedIn Recruiter, AI-enabled search technologies, and talent mapping techniques
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights

Descripción del puesto:

Tornero Convencional | Vallejo, Ciudad de México




En Lemon & Morgan Head Hunter buscamos para nuestro cliente, una empresa mexicana especializada en la fabricación de pines, medallas, monedas conmemorativas y artículos metálicos personalizados, una persona para la posición de Tornero Convencional.




Esta posición es para alguien preciso, cuidadoso y con experiencia real en el manejo de torno convencional. Buscamos una persona que entienda que tornear no es únicamente retirar material: es fabricar piezas con medidas exactas, respetar tolerancias y asegurar que cada componente funcione correctamente dentro del proceso de producción.




Responsabilidades

Operar torno convencional para la fabricación y ajuste de piezas metálicas.

Fabricar piezas pequeñas y de precisión conforme a medidas, muestras o planos.

Realizar trabajos de cilindrado, refrentado, barrenado, roscado, desbaste y acabado.

Fabricar, ajustar y reparar pernos, bujes, ejes, punzones, matrices, cuños y componentes para troqueles.

Detectar desviaciones y realizar los ajustes necesarios antes de liberar una pieza.

Apoyar en la reparación y mantenimiento de herramientas y componentes de producción.

Mantener el torno, las herramientas y el área de trabajo en condiciones adecuadas de operación, limpieza y seguridad.




Requisitos

Experiencia previa indispensable como tornero convencional.

Experiencia comprobable en fabricación de piezas metálicas de precisión.

Dominio de operaciones básicas y avanzadas de torno convencional.

Manejo de vernier, micrómetro y herramientas de medición.

Conocimiento en materiales, herramientas de corte, velocidades y avances.

Deseable experiencia en fabricación de troqueles, matrices, moldes, cuños, punzones o componentes similares.

Alto nivel de precisión, responsabilidad, concentración y cuidado por los detalles.




Ofrecemos

Sueldo mensual de $15,000 libres.

Horario de lunes a viernes de 8:30 a.m. a 6:30 p.m.

Trabajo presencial en la zona de Vallejo, Ciudad de México.

Empleo estable y de tiempo completo.

Oportunidad de integrarte a una empresa mexicana especializada en productos metálicos personalizados.

Desarrollo de experiencia en fabricación de piezas para pines, medallas, monedas y artículos conmemorativos.




¿Por qué postularte?

Porque podrás integrarte a una empresa Estable especializada, donde la calidad del trabajo del tornero impacta directamente en la precisión de los moldes, troqueles, cuños y componentes utilizados en la producción.




Es una posición ideal para una persona que busca estabilidad, que disfruta trabajar con medidas exactas y que quiere aplicar su experiencia en la fabricación de piezas pequeñas y de alta precisión.

Postúlate si cuentas con experiencia previa indispensable en torno convencional, y puedes garantizar piezas precisas, funcionales y bien terminadas.




Envía tu CV a sophiaheadhunter2@gmail.com

o por WhatsApp al 55 3235 6612.

About the job

About Inhabit

Inhabit is a global PropTech software company serving over 5 million units in the residential and short-term rental property management industries. Our 1,500+ team members drive strategic partnerships, deliver best-in-class software solutions and services, and foster innovation and collaboration across software, payments, and insurance. Learn more at, visit inhabit.com.

About Streamline

Streamline is a leading software platform built for professional vacation rental and property management companies. Our technology powers the full operational lifecycle of property managers — from reservations, distribution, and accounting to maintenance operations, guest communications, and owner experience.

We partner with professional property managers to help them streamline operations, scale efficiently, maximize revenue, and deliver exceptional guest experiences through automation, data, and modern technology.

As we continue expanding globally, including strategic growth initiatives across Mexico and emerging international markets, we are investing in high-performing sales professionals who are passionate about technology, hospitality, and helping property managers grow their businesses.

Job Description

The Account Executive is responsible for generating, managing, and closing new business opportunities within the vacation rental and property management industry. This role focuses on proactive outbound prospecting, consultative sales engagement, relationship development, and guiding prospective clients through the full sales cycle.

As part of Streamline’s international growth strategy, this position plays a key role in expanding our presence across Mexico and emerging markets throughout the region. We are seeking a highly motivated, self-driven sales professional who thrives in fast-paced environments, and is comfortable navigating evolving markets.

The ideal candidate combines strong business development skills with a consultative approach, enabling them to engage with property management companies ranging from growing operators to large, multi-market organizations. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust quickly, identify operational challenges, communicate business value effectively, and develop long-term client relationships.

What You’ll Do (Functions & Responsibilities)



Generate new business through outbound prospecting, networking, and partner channels
Manage the full sales cycle: discovery, solution positioning, demos, proposal, and close
Conduct consultative sales conversations with property management leaders and stakeholders
Deliver product demonstrations aligned to prospect needs and operational challenges
Develop a strong understanding of Streamline’s platform, industry trends, and the operational challenges facing professional property managers
Build and manage a strong pipeline within assigned territory (Mexico / LATAM markets)
Re-engage prior prospects and inactive customers to reopen opportunities
Collaborate with marketing, partnerships, and account management to drive pipeline growth
Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and activity tracking within CRM systems 
Represent Streamline at industry events, conferences, and market visits as needed



Qualifications

What We’re Looking For (Minimum qualifications)



4+ years of sales experience in SaaS, property management, proptech, or related industries 
Proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a closing role 
Experience managing full-cycle sales processes in a consultative environment 
Strong communication and presentation skills, including virtual demos 
Ability to navigate multiple stakeholders and influence decision-makers 
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in a growth/expansion market 
Experience working in or selling into Mexico or Latin America 
Bilingual (Spanish/English) 
Strong business acumen and data-driven mindset



Education Requirements



Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred

Full time

Remote Mexico

About the job

¡Ayúdanos a impulsar el futuro de la tecnología en salud!

En Top Doctors Group trabajamos para mejorar la forma en la que las personas acceden a la atención médica. A través de la tecnología, conectamos pacientes, profesionales sanitarios y clínicas para ofrecer una experiencia más accesible, eficiente y humana.

Hoy estamos presentes en 10 países y desarrollamos soluciones digitales que ayudan a miles de profesionales sanitarios a potenciar su actividad y a millones de personas a encontrar la atención sanitaria que necesitan.

Creemos que la tecnología genera un mayor impacto cuando se pone al servicio de las personas. Por eso seguimos creciendo y buscando talento que quiera ayudarnos a construir el futuro de la salud digital en un entorno internacional, innovador y en constante evolución.

💡 ¿Por qué este rol es interesante?

Porque tendrás un impacto directo en el crecimiento de Top Doctors en Latinoamérica. Como Performance Marketing Specialist, liderarás la estrategia de captación digital de pacientes, médicos y centros médicos, siendo responsable de generar oportunidades de negocio a través de campañas de paid media orientadas a resultados.

Tendrás ownership sobre todo el ciclo de las campañas: desde la definición de la estrategia y la gestión de presupuestos hasta la optimización continua y el análisis de resultados. Trabajarás de forma muy cercana con los equipos de Ventas, Marketing y Revenue para asegurar que los leads generados se conviertan en crecimiento real para el negocio.

Tu trabajo tendrá una influencia directa en métricas clave como la generación de leads, el coste de adquisición, la calidad del pipeline comercial y el retorno de la inversión publicitaria, contribuyendo al crecimiento de una de las compañías HealthTech líderes en Latinoamérica.

Planear, implementar y optimizar campañas de paid media en Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) y redes de afiliados.
Liderar la captación digital de los tres segmentos clave: pacientes, médicos/especialistas y centros médicos o clínicas.

👀 Nos encantará conocerte si…

Si Disfrutas Tomando Decisiones Basadas En Datos, Optimizando Campañas Con Impacto Real En El Negocio y Trabajando En Entornos Donde Marketing y Revenue Están Estrechamente Conectados, Probablemente Encajarás Muy Bien En Este Rol Si Tienes

Más Allá De La Experiencia Técnica, Creemos Que Las Personas Que Mejor Encajan En Este Tipo De Posición Suelen Compartir Algunas Formas De Trabajar

✔ Toman decisiones basadas en datos y entienden cómo sus acciones impactan en métricas de negocio como el ROI, la rentabilidad y el crecimiento.

✔ Se sienten cómodas trabajando en entornos dinámicos, adaptándose con rapidez a los cambios de mercado, nuevas plataformas, algoritmos y comportamientos de los usuarios.

No creemos en las candidaturas perfectas ni en los perfiles que encajan al 100% sobre el papel, más allá de la experiencia concreta, valoramos aquellas competencias, habilidades y formas de trabajar que permiten aportar valor al equipo y contribuir al crecimiento de la compañía. Si crees que este reto puede encajar contigo, ¡aplica ahora!

Fundada en 2013, Top Doctors Group es un grupo de empresas tecnológicas líder en la digitalización del sector sanitario. A lo largo de nuestra trayectoria, hemos incorporado empresas especializadas y ampliado nuestro modelo hacia soluciones B2B, consolidándonos como un referente internacional en salud digital.

Nuestro propósito es claro: ayudar a cada persona a encontrar al mejor especialista cuando más lo necesita. Hoy, más de 1 millón de personas consultan nuestras plataformas cada mes y más de 10 millones de pacientes han confiado en nosotros en Europa, LATAM, Estados Unidos y Oriente Medio.

A través de nuestras marcas —Top Doctors, Top Health Tech, Ofimedic, iWantGreatCare, Manitex y Top Farma— impulsamos una atención médica más innovadora, eficiente y humana. Somos una compañía global en crecimiento continuo, con un propósito firme: transformar el futuro de la salud a través de la tecnología, el talento y la innovación.

About the job

Descripción de la Compañía:

Ferrero es una empresa familiar con una perspectiva verdaderamente mundial y progresista y marcas icónicas como Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® y Kinder Sorpresa®. El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Únete a nosotros, podrías ser uno de ellos.

Acerca del Rol:

En Ferrero trabajamos con grandes ideas para ganar el corazón de muchas familias en el mundo, y tú puedes ser parte del equipo que contribuya a hacer las marcas de Ferrero aún más extraordinarias. Únete al equipo en un rol de Brand Assistant Kinder Chocolate donde tendrás la oportunidad de coordinar y gestionar la marca a diario, asegurando que todos los procesos administrativos se realicen de manera eficiente y dentro de los plazos establecidos. Serás clave en el seguimiento de los deadlines de los proyectos, contribuyendo directamente al cumplimiento de los objetivos de ventas. Además, tendrás un rol activo en el desarrollo de estrategias innovadoras y en la planificación que impulsará el crecimiento y éxito de la marca.

¡Esta oportunidad puede ser interesante para ti!

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

description:
About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Graduate Partner Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Graduate Partner Marketing Manager, you aren’t just running campaigns; you are architecting the strategic relationships that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with the titans of tech:


Public cloud: AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle.
Silicon: NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD.
Global hardware: Dell, HP, Lenovo.



Early careers & growth

We are specifically looking for recent graduates who are serious about their success and ready to make a global impact. At Canonical, we prioritize talent and potential over years of experience; we will teach you the technical and commercial nuances of the open-source world through our structured career journey program. You will gain experience working with top tier talent and with multiple enterprise technologies. If you have the drive and a high standard for excellence, we provide the platform for you to become a world-class marketing leader.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region and will report to the Partner Marketing Team Manager.

Your impact


Architect joint success: Build high-velocity go-to-market plans with global partners, moving from initial messaging to full-scale pipeline generation.
Launch at scale: Lead integrated campaigns, industry announcements, and product launches that reach everyone from developers to C-suite decision-makers.
Creative packaging: Translate cutting-edge tech in the open-source world into educational and marketing content that resonates.
Ecosystem evolution: Shape and scale our partner programs to keep pace with an ever-expanding network of hardware vendors, software vendors, and channel resellers.



What We’re Looking For


The marketing basics: You understand how marketing works (especially within enterprises) and have familiarity with common marketing platforms, social media, and business technology.
The relationship builder: You can navigate complex and dynamic organizations and build lasting rapport.
The analytical thinker: You obsess over value and use data to decide which experiments to scale and which to iterate.
The self-starter: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment and aren't afraid to "roll up your sleeves" to get a project across the finish line.



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.


Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events



About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

Translate user and business needs into high-level requirements for work assignments of low to medium complexity by utilizing a structured process for gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing change to assess and recommend solutions based on cost vs. benefit analysis and parallels to overall business strategy.
Assist in defining acceptance criteria for product features of low to medium complexity, and ensuring they are understood by the delivery team.
Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure product success. Monitor product performance, analyze data, and make data-driven decisions to improve product outcomes.

Maintain detailed documentation, such as gap analyses, business process flow charts, decision tables, features, and business requirements document to aid in the development and refinement of new analytical tools and processes.
Provide input and support during implementation phase, composing standard operating procedures (SOPs), and participating in design reviews and walk throughs.

Collaborate closely with Quality Engineering (QE) to ensure the product meets high standards of quality, performance and reliability by defining the product requirements and acceptance criteria, which are then used by the QE team to develop test plans and test cases.
Monitor product performance after implementation to ensure efficiency of operations and proactively provide continuous improvement recommendations.
Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer support teams to ensure successful product development and launch.
Facilitate communication and alignment across departments to achieve product goals.
Actively participate in all squad ceremonies.
Review work completed by the squad, provide feedback, and accept work, as applicable.
Assist in the management of the product backlog by grooming and prioritizing, while ensuring work is in line with product strategy and OKRs.
Develop and maintain relationships with customers and business partners to drive satisfaction.
Ability to collaborate and operate in a cross-cultural and complex matrixed environment to build consensus across functions.
Communicate product updates and releases to internal and external stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Uphold company mission and values through accountability, innovation, integrity, quality, and teamwork.
Support and comply with the company’s Quality Management System policies and procedures.
Maintain regular and reliable attendance.
Ability to act with an inclusion mindset and model these behaviors for the organization.

Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Marketing, Business, Finance or field as outlined in the essential duties; or High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) and 4 years of relevant experience as outlined in the essential duties instead of Bachelor’s Degree.
4+ years of relevant professional experience as outlined in the essential duties.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Trello, Asana). Understanding of software development processes.
Demonstrated ability to perform the essential duties of the position with or without accommodation.
Experience in life science, healthcare, bioinformatics, wellness, or digital health.

Knowledge of digital analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics, Tableau, Google Analytics, etc., A/B testing tools such as AB Tasty, Optimizely, MoEngage, etc., and/or design tools such as Adobe XD, Figma, Sketch, etc.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

GBS's primary goal is to ensure operational excellence across deal cycles, increase revenue through the development of transformative commercial constructs, and drive closure of Stripe's deal portfolio. The team's reach is widespread across Stripe, not exclusive to one sales segment or geographical region; GBS drives change across go-to-market, positively impacting Stripe users and cross-functional teams. GBS's priorities are set through the direction of Stripe leadership and executive vision, partnership with sales and cross-functional organizations, as well as user feedback and market insights.

What you'll do

Stripe's Global Business Services (GBS) team is looking for a Deal Strategist to focus on the closure of custom and standard commercial deals. You will be responsible for deal lifecycle management and supporting cross-organizational alignment. This role requires a background in driving custom deals to closure, a strong understanding of pricing frameworks, and experience supporting sales through negotiations.

The candidate will have experience with SaaS products, pricing strategies, and supporting selling motions, along with strong communication skills. You will love this job if you are a natural relationship builder and process architect.

Responsibilities


Manage end-to-end customer deals—drafting, editing, and reviewing agreements—while supporting the sales cycle to ensure deal terms align with business goals, reflect strategic priorities, and close as forecasted.
Act as the primary point of contact between Sales, Legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders for deal-related questions, approvals, and escalations.
Work directly with sales teams, sales leaders, services/support teams, and customers to advise on deal structures, establish compelling commercials, and drive resolution of customer issues.
Advise sales teams on the best approach by understanding customer and partner requirements, while balancing custom terms with internal system constraints.
Remove internal blockers and drive alignment across cross-functional teams including Product, Legal, Finance, and Accounting.
Support complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial and legal agreements.
Support the pricing and structuring of multi-threaded product use cases in all segments and industries, especially in highly competitive sales cycles.
Quickly build credibility and trust with internal stakeholders.
Demonstrate strong communication and persuasion skills when working with cross-functional partners and senior leaders.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

Minimum Requirements


BA/BS degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or Economics
6+ years of experience in deal strategy, procurement, pricing strategy, financial consulting, or legal
Experience working in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments and comfortable operating with high agency
Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and project management skills
Experience working in Payments and/or SaaS



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

About the job

Company Description ClimateCard.xyz empowers individuals and organizations to offset their carbon footprint through small, affordable climate cards that fund verifiable carbon abatement projects worldwide. Operating within the EigenCarbon ecosystem, each Climate Card purchase is transparently linked to on-chain transactions, ensuring that corresponding EigenCarbon Coins are bought and permanently burned to retire CO₂ emissions. The platform offers a simple, step-by-step experience from purchase to impact tracking, giving users clear visibility into their climate contributions. ClimateCard.xyz focuses on accessible climate action, transparency, and measurable impact, making it easy to gift or invest in a greener future.
Role Description The Latam Partnerships role is a full-time remote position responsible for developing and managing strategic relationships across Latin America to expand ClimateCard.xyz’s presence and impact. Daily activities include identifying and prospecting potential partners such as fintechs, climate-focused organizations, NGOs, and corporate sustainability teams, and presenting tailored partnership proposals. The role involves negotiating partnership terms, coordinating integrations and campaigns, and working closely with internal teams (product, marketing, operations) to ensure partner success and user growth. The Latam Partnerships team member will analyze market trends and performance data, provide feedback to improve offerings, and represent ClimateCard.xyz in regional meetings, events, and digital communities. This position requires self-directed work, frequent virtual communication with stakeholders, and a strong commitment to climate action and impact-driven collaboration.
Qualifications
 
Strong Partnerships and Strategic Partnerships skills to identify, build, and maintain high-value relationships in the Latam region.
Sales and Communication skills to pitch solutions, negotiate agreements, and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
Analytical Skills to evaluate market opportunities, measure partnership performance, and inform data-driven decisions.
Experience or strong interest in climate tech, sustainability, fintech, or impact-driven startups.
Fluency in Spanish and professional proficiency in English; Portuguese is a plus.
Proven ability to work remotely, manage multiple projects, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, International Relations, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Familiarity with Web3, blockchain, or digital assets is an advantage but not required.

About the job

Role: Web Browsing Analyst (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Job Type: Contract
Payout: $30 - $45/hour




Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Web Browsing Evaluator to work on a contract basis. The role involves assessing the quality, relevance, and accuracy of web search results and browsing experiences. Evaluators will follow detailed guidelines to provide feedback on search engine performance and user interface effectiveness.




Key Responsibilities:

• Assess the relevance and accuracy of web search results based on specific queries and user intent.

• Evaluate the quality of web pages, including content accuracy, usability, and adherence to search engine guidelines.

• Provide detailed feedback on the browsing experience, including page load times, navigation, and overall user satisfaction.

• Identify and report issues such as broken links, outdated content, or misleading information in search results.

• Follow structured evaluation guidelines to ensure consistency and reliability in assessments.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Demonstrated ability to follow detailed written instructions and provide constructive feedback.

• Familiarity with web browsing, search engines, and basic understanding of how search algorithms function.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate content for accuracy and relevance.

• Basic computer literacy and proficiency in using web browsers.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a remote setting.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the improvement of search engine accuracy and user experience. Evaluators play a critical role in refining how information is delivered to users worldwide.




Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.




Apply Now!

title: Bilingual Bookkeeper and Accounting Virtual Assistant (Spanish and English) | Remote | Full-Time
description:
About the job

A company in the accounting software (SaaS) industry is looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Bilingual Bookkeeper and Accounting Virtual Assistant to join their growing team. This is a fully remote, full-time position working 40 hours per week, aligned to Central Standard Time (CST). We are building a high-performing team and are only looking for true A-Players who are ready to go the extra mile in a fast-paced environment.




If you are bilingual in Spanish and English, have solid bookkeeping experience, love learning new technology, and take pride in delivering excellent client support, we want to hear from you.










ABOUT THE ROLE




You will be working directly with our internal team and clients to support the onboarding, testing, and day-to-day use of our proprietary accounting software platform. You will play a key role in helping us refine the product, support new clients, and perform real bookkeeping work using our system. This is not a passive role. We need someone who takes initiative, communicates clearly in both English and Spanish, and thrives when given responsibility.










RESPONSIBILITIES




- Learn and become proficient in our proprietary accounting software, REVREX

- Assist in identifying and documenting software bugs and inconsistencies during testing phases

- Help configure and set up client accounts within the platform in preparation for onboarding new users

- Provide responsive support to newly onboarded clients, answering questions and guiding them through the software

- Perform general bookkeeping tasks on behalf of clients using the REVREX platform

- Communicate clearly and professionally with clients in both English and Spanish

- Work flexibly and adapt quickly to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment

- Collaborate with the internal team to improve processes and client experience










QUALIFICATIONS




- Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online (QBO certification is a strong plus)

- Fluent in both Spanish and English, with a clear and professional speaking accent in both languages

- Strong understanding of bookkeeping and general accounting principles

- Comfortable learning new software platforms quickly and providing detailed feedback

- Experience in client-facing support or customer success roles is an advantage

- Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to manage tasks independently in a remote setting

- Reliable internet connection and a professional home office setup

- Availability to work full-time (40 hours per week) on a CST schedule with flexibility as needed

- A team-first mindset with a genuine drive to go above and beyond










POSITION DETAILS




- Type: Full-Time, Remote

- Hours: 40 hours per week

- Schedule: Central Standard Time (CST)

- Location: Work from anywhere (remote)
